Your AI Voice privacy choices

Each text transcript you submit with Generate Quote is saved to your QuoteDr account.

  • Text history: The submitted text remains in your account until you delete it or your account is removed.
  • Private to your account: Other customers cannot access it. It is not sold or used for advertising.
  • Support access is limited: QuoteDr staff do not routinely view your records. Support transcript access requires a real investigation reason and is audited.
  • You stay in control: You can view, copy, or delete saved transcripts from Transcript History.
Choose your account default before AI Voice can use the microphone
  • Private to your account: QuoteDr Support cannot listen unless you explicitly authorize that specific recording for a specific customer-support case.
  • Every authorized support lookup and playback is case-bound and audited.
  • Audio is private to your account and automatically deleted after 14 days unless you preserve it for an active support case. After case closure, it is deleted after the existing 30-day post-case period unless you delete it sooner.
  • Avoid dictating access codes or unnecessary sensitive information. You can pause recording during a private conversation.
  • Audio is investigation evidence for human review, not automatic proof or a guarantee of compensation.

Your choice is saved as your account default and is shown whenever you open Voice To Quote. You can change it later.

The submitted text is also processed by QuoteDr's AI provider to create the quote draft.
